separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Hydrogenic formulas and immutable finite-basis helium reference cards Map existing H/He formulas and saved finite-basis references to units, normalization and model limits. Assumptions, units and boundaries Three saved 40-function He reference rows, hydrogenic analytic equations, p versus n and finite-grid/basis/model limits. Energies in hartree, radius in bohr; u in bohr^-1/2, p in bohr^-1 and n in bohr^-3. Three saved rows each use40basis functions, not40computed rows. Editorial clarification Curation and saved-value audit only: zero new SCF/independent-reference runs. No correlated-exact He, complete-basis limit or full orbital rerun claim. Adopted numerical method Audit existing formulas and three stored energy rows; distinguish radial from volume density and orbital from total energy.
